findings.description: The evidence records the exact targeted command as 18 tests passed with no unverified item, but independent replay at reviewedStateCommit 04296b53573e940e046259fea589d3c351368cf7 completes 17/18. The failing test clones the current canonical branch and therefore imports GCR-0007.B00.state.json in REVIEW; it nevertheless asserts validate_current_boundary(..., state_required=False) returns (None, None), an absent-state precondition. The test is ambient-HEAD dependent and the submitted verification claim is false at the immutable review boundary.
findings.reproduction: At exact HEAD 04296b53573e940e046259fea589d3c351368cf7 on codex/w1-windows-local-runtime, run `.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m unittest -v tests.foundation.test_gcr7ctl tests.foundation.test_taskctl_schema.BacklogSchemaTests.test_revision_twelve_headroom_requires_exact_neutral_gcr7_and_s03 tests.foundation.test_taskctl_schema.BacklogSchemaTests.test_neutral_gcr7_does_not_change_the_w1_a04_postappend_denial tests.foundation.test_recoveryctl.GovernanceRecoveryTests.test_v5_schema_is_exact_to_s03_b03_and_gcr7 tests.foundation.test_recoveryctl.GovernanceRecoveryTests.test_v5_preappend_boundary_requires_gcr7_and_preserves_backlog`. Observe `FAILED (failures=1)` after 17 passing tests. The failure is tests.foundation.test_gcr7ctl.Gcr7ctlTests.test_status_boundary_denies_dirt_transaction_and_substituted_predecessor at the assertion expecting `(None, None)`; the actual first tuple element is the committed REVIEW state copied by clone_authority_repo. Preserve R01 append-only, make a strict-descendant R02 test remediation that constructs or checks out an explicit state-absent authority boundary rather than ambient branch HEAD, add a separate assertion for the frozen REVIEW-state boundary, bind fresh evidence with this finding's closure, and resubmit through gcr7ctl.
